banner.description: You and your friend each get 10% of the friend's swap points.
banner.title: Boost Your Rank – Refer & Earn!

column.swapCapWarning: Stake or delegate more to raise your cap.

tooltip.delegation:
Points for the GNS you keep delegated.

Delegated value (In GNOT) × days × time bonus × 0.003
Time bonus:
- 0 ~ 10 days: ×1
- 10 ~ 20 days: ×1.5
- 20 ~ 30 days: ×1.75
- 30 days ~: ×2

GNS waiting in the 7-day unbonding period and deposited GNS through launchpad earn no point.
tooltip.points:
Total Point

Staking + Delegation + Swap + Referral

Points are measured in GNOT, not USD.

Referral: 10% of your own swap points, plus 10% of each friend's swap points.

Global cap: if everyone's swap points add up to more than everyone's staking + delegation points, all swap points shrink by the same ratio. Set at round end.
tooltip.position: Swap fees claimed in USD. Only counts if the pool is receiving $GNS incentives.
tooltip.staking:
Points for the value you keep in staked positions.

Position value (In GNOT) × days in range × time bonus × 0.003
Time bonus:
- 0 ~ 5 days: ×0
- 5 ~ 10 days: ×1
- 10 ~ 20 days: ×1.5
- 20 ~ 30 days: ×1.75
- 30 days ~: ×2

Only counts while in range, in pools with internal GNS emissions. Narrow or wide range makes no difference. Unstaking restarts the time bonus.
tooltip.swap:
Points for the swap fee (router fee) you pay.

Swap fee paid (In GNOT) × 5, up to your Swap Cap
Swap Cap: Delegation points × 3 + Staking points × 1
No staking or delegation = no swap points. Only swaps that go through pools with internal GNS emissions.
tooltip.volume: Swap fees paid in USD. Only counts if the pool is receiving internal $GNS incentives.

tooltip.hideToggleButton: Your username or address will be hidden. Other users will not be able to see your positions.
tooltip.nextUpdateTime: Updates every 10 minutes. The current hour is provisional until it closes.

subHeader.description: Climb up the leaderboard by collecting points for swapping, staking, delegating, or inviting friends. Every activity on GnoSwap counts!
